Rank Hypotheses

Rank hypotheses using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

rank_hypotheses(hypotheses)

Example input

{
  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "name": "Expired token",
      "evidence_count": 0,
      "check": "Inspect expiry"
    },
    {
      "name": "Missing header",
      "evidence_count": 1,
      "check": "Inspect request"
    }
  ]
}

Example output

[
  {
    "name": "Missing header",
    "evidence_count": 1,
    "check": "Inspect request"
  },
  {
    "name": "Expired token",
    "evidence_count": 0,
    "check": "Inspect expiry"
  }
]

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py rank_hypotheses < examples/rank-hypotheses.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
